left.title: Harley-Davidson is a loser in Trump’s trade war
left.body: Harley-Davidson is shifting production of its European-bound motorcycles overseas because of tariffs.
left.roundup: Harley Davidson will move production of motorcycles sold in Europe from U.S. facilities to factories overseas in order to offset retaliatory EU tariffs on American exports.

center.title: EU tariffs force Harley-Davidson to shift some production overseas
center.body: Production of Harley-Davidson motorcycles sold in Europe will move from U.S. factories to facilities overseas, the Milwaukee-based company announced Monday, a consequence of the retaliatory tariffs the EU is imposing on American exports in an escalating trade war with the Trump administration.
center.roundup: Harley Davidson will move production of motorcycles sold in Europe from U.S. facilities to factories overseas in order to offset retaliatory EU tariffs on American exports.

right.title: Trump Calls out Harley-Davidson for Moving Production Overseas Due to Tariffs
right.body: President Donald Trump called out Harley-Davidson for moving some of its production overseas due to tariffs placed on the U.S. by European countries.
right.roundup: Harley Davidson will move production of motorcycles sold in Europe from U.S. facilities to factories overseas in order to offset retaliatory EU tariffs on American exports.
